name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest *open* PR first. It’s the fastest way to validate fixes before they merge, catching issues early without slowing down contributors. The trade-off is delayed feedback for merged PRs, but open PRs are the higher-leverage target.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on the newest *open* PR risks missing systemic issues buried in merged code—edge cases only exposed after broader usage. Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the *oldest merged* PR first; it surfaces latent bugs before they compound, while the newest open PR’s fixes are still speculative. Settle it by measuring how many critical issues each approach catches in the next two weeks.

name: Overhaul
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest *merged* PR first, then expand to oldest merged PRs—this catches fixes already proven safe while still exposing systemic issues before they compound.

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest *merged* PR first. Merged PRs contain fixes already proven safe by contributors, so shadow mode here validates PR-Agent’s feedback against real-world changes without risking new code. This catches systemic gaps in PR-Agent’s review logic before it scales to older merged PRs, where compounding issues lurk. The trade-off is delayed feedback for open PRs, but merged PRs are the higher-leverage target for improving PR-Agent’s accuracy.
